lines: Peene walon, suno.
couplets.en: Listen, you who drink.

lines: Peene walon, suno, peene walon, suno.
Suno, suno, suno.
couplets.en: Listen, you who drink, listen.

lines: Peene walon, suno, na chhupa kar piyo.
Kabhi ishq aur sharaab ko mila kar piyo.
couplets.en: You who drink in secret, try mingling love with your wine.

lines: Peene walon, suno, na chhupa kar piyo.
Kabhi ishq aur sharaab ko mila kar piyo.
couplets.en: You who drink in secret, try mingling love with your wine.

lines: Tum kahoge, yeh kaise mumkin hai, yaar?
couplets.en: How can that be, my friend, you will ask.

lines: Saamne tum sanam ko bitha kar piyo.
Aur nazar se nazar phir mila kar piyo.
couplets.en: Drink with your beloved sitting across from you, and let your eyes meet.

lines: Jab chhalakte hain jaam leke dilbar ka naam,
To rangin hoti hai aur shaam.
couplets.en: The evening deepens in color when the cups brim over at the mention of the beloved.

lines: Jab jawani pe ho maikashi ka yeh daur,
To maza aashiqi ka aata hai, yaar.
couplets.en: When the wine goes round in youth, my friend, you learn how sweet it is to love.

lines: Aur is daur mein sab bhula kar piyo.
Kabhi ishq aur sharaab ko mila kar piyo.
couplets.en: Let everything slip away as the cup goes round, and try mingling love with your wine.

lines: Jab piyoge kabhi jaise kehte hain hum,
To mit jayenge saare dard aur gham.
couplets.en: Drink as I suggest one day, and all your pain and sorrow will fade.

lines: Jab behak jayenge had se zyada qadam,
To sambhalega tumko tumhara sanam.
couplets.en: When you stray too far and your steps falter, your beloved will steady you.

lines: Dar hai kis baat ka, sar utha kar piyo.
Kabhi ishq aur sharaab ko mila kar piyo.
couplets.en: What is there to fear when you can lift your head and drink your wine mingled with love?
